pr_title: Fix AEMET gathering information process for precipitation values
pr_body:

## Proposed change
Fix the process of gathering the forecast information from AEMET for the values of precipitation and precipitation probabilities.

The code I removed was not necessary since earlier those values where already set to 0 as default, so no need to return null or to check those cases because it would be anyway 0.

issue_context.title: AEMET integration is returning null for precipitation_probability instead of 0
issue_context.body:
### The problem

In weather forecast, AEMET integration is returning null for precipitation_probability instead of 0 when data type is integer.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2022.10.4

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

aemet

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/aemet/

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

_No response_

### Additional information

This is weather.aemet_daily entity data:
```
temperature: 18
temperature_unit: °C
humidity: 45
pressure_unit: hPa
wind_bearing: 0
wind_speed: 2
wind_speed_unit: km/h
visibility_unit: km
precipitation_unit: mm
forecast: 
- condition: partlycloudy
  precipitation_probability: null
  datetime: '2022-10-13T22:00:00+00:00'
  wind_bearing: 225
  temperature: 26
  templow: 14
  wind_speed: 5
...
```
precipitation_probability is null instead of 0.

review_comments: This will change the precipitation from None to 0 for this case. Is that correct? Ie is a missing value the same as 0 precipitation?

The problem is that in the last two lines of code it will already set it to 0 even though the incoming raw value could be None, so given that the intention was to set it to 0 then setting it back to None is not helpful

Also In my opinion it is more "playable" if the value is 0 other than None since None I believe shows "Unknown" in the frontend

We represent unknown value with `None` in Home Assistant. The existing code seems correct to me although it may perhaps be longer than needed as you point out. Someone familiar with the Aemet API needs to clarify what missing value means with this API though.

> We represent unknown value with `None` in Home Assistant. The existing code seems correct to me although it may perhaps be longer than needed as you point out. Someone familiar with the Aemet API needs to clarify what missing value means with this API though.

I will check this and report back, because I don't remember what the actual behaviour of the API is...

@MartinHjelmare so I checked the AEMET API and the value is never missing, since the value is set to 0 when there's no precipitation expected.
This behaviour is the same for precipitation and precipitation probability.
If precipitation values are always present we should simplify the code more and remove all the optional return values for those code paths.
